thread:
oliver: FYI vendor issued an embargoed note about an HSM firmware quirk that can produce malformed attestation blobs for certain BYOK signing paths. Need fast triage: RBAC, audit export, and KMS fallback. Can someone take lead?
rhea: DM the advisory? Is exploitability known?
oliver: Sent DM; vendor says exploit needs operator console but treat as high risk. Customer saw attestation fail after patch.
megan: Ops immediate steps: disable auto-updates on affected pools, raise audit level for Wrap/Unwrap/Attest, snapshot attestation blobs and upload to secure vault, tag keys for emergency rewrap.
ops-bot: ALERT: unusual WrapKey rate detected on hsm-prod-2. Incident #7100012346 created. :rotating_light: 
rhea: RBAC mitigation: enumerate principals with both WrapKey and ExportKey, then apply short deny for ExportKey and enable JIT for hsm-admin. I can run the scan and correlate logs.
oliver: Quick log query example to run against clusters:
``nresource.type="hsm_key" protoPayload.methodName="WrapKey"
```
Run across regions and correlate principal IDs.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow BYOK incident runbook and notify Compliance/Legal if keys protect regulated data. Link: https://redwood-internal/security/incident-byok
megan: Actions: @rhea run IAM+audit correlation and upload artifacts; I'll open a short RBAC PR to deny export where wrap exists and add kms-proxy soft-wrap notes as a fallback; @oliver coordinate vendor communication and draft a concise customer notice offering rewrap + audit package. Keep updates here.
rhea: Scan complete, DMed oliver results. Found 2 principals with Wrap+Export in prod-eu. Logs and attestation blobs are in secure-share (sensitive).
oliver: Thanks—warroom invite going out for 25m. If vendor confirms exploitability we'll escalate severity and prepare a forensic package for affected BYOK customers. :thumbsup:
